title: Nicotine Addiction (Cigarettes & Vaping)
description:
These affirmations are designed to support your recovery journey by strengthening your commitment,

building resilience, and encouraging self-compassion. Repeat them each morning, reflect on them
throughout the day, and journal about how they apply to your healing.

safety.disclaimer: This programme complements counselling, hypnotherapy, EFT, and trusted accountability. It is not a medical cure.
safety.reminder: Nicotine recovery is built one craving and one day at a time. These affirmations complement counseling and healthy replacement routines.

modules.title: Awareness & Commitment
focus: I acknowledge my addiction without letting it define me.
My recovery begins with today's choices.

modules.title: Healing & Self-Care
focus: My body is repairing itself every day.
I care for myself with patience and compassion.
Healthy habits are replacing old patterns.

modules.title: Strength & Growth
focus: I am stronger than my cravings.
Every challenge makes me more resilient.
I trust my ability to remain nicotine-free.

modules.title: Freedom & Renewal
focus: Nicotine no longer controls my life.
Iembrace a healthier future with confidence.
My recovery is becoming my new way of life.

activities.title: Closing affirmation and forward plan
activities.affirmation:
I am not defined by nicotine or my past habits. I am defined by my courage, determination, and
commitment to healing. Every day I remain nicotine-free, I reclaim my health, strengthen my spirit,
and move closer to the vibrant, fulfilling life I deserve. One breath, one choice, and one day at a
time-I am free.

fields.label: What will you keep practising after this journey?
What support do you still want?
Share this closing plan with Gerald
